collect.//: These paths are hand-maintained and go stale the moment an article is renamed or unpublished -- which is exactly how this list ended up pointing at a deleted post and failing a build. tests/seo/lighthouse-urls.spec.ts asserts every path here exists in dist/, so the breakage now surfaces in the fast test job instead of after a three-run Lighthouse pass. Two pages are here specifically because they carry images and are therefore the most demanding for LCP, which is the number this budget exists to defend: the article with a cover, and /open-source/, whose first image is eager and sits below the fold. A page with images that nothing measures is how a performance regression ships.

assertMatrix.//: The 404 page is deliberately noindex, which Lighthouse scores as an SEO failure. It is scored on everything else.
Every indexable page. SEO is held at a perfect score because every signal it measures is within our control.
